content.title: Two-Wave Airstrike Loop | Overhead Battle and Return Salvo
content.summary: A coastal fleet uses a smoke-screen opening and return-route flare convergence. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One continuous overhead geography establishes objective, formations and structures before attack. + The first strike changes a local route or defensive state instead of functioning as decoration. + Units react within the same registered map between attack waves. + A second, distinguishable route or weapon pattern revisits the same objective with greater coverage. + The terminal hold preserves surviving units, damaged objective and persistent aftermath on the original map.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original tabletop-style coastal defense map with two adult-commanded fleets, three harbor structures and one central radar tower. Keep radar, harbor and fleet positions registered as one escort group moves through that gap and defenders pivot toward it. Hold the same overhead geography after the final impacts, showing the disabled tower, surviving units and persistent smoke corridors.
required_anchors: One continuous overhead geography establishes objective, formations and structures before attack.
The first strike changes a local route or defensive state instead of functioning as decoration.
A second, distinguishable route or weapon pattern revisits the same objective with greater coverage.
The terminal hold preserves surviving units, damaged objective and persistent aftermath on the original map.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A coastal fleet uses a smoke-screen opening and return-route flare convergence. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A coastal fleet uses a smoke-screen opening and return-route flare convergence. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One continuous overhead geography establishes objective, formations and structures before attack.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One continuous overhead geography establishes objective, formations and structures before attack."

invariants.rule: The first strike changes a local route or defensive state instead of functioning as decoration.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The first strike changes a local route or defensive state instead of functioning as decoration."

invariants.rule: Units react within the same registered map between attack waves.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Units react within the same registered map between attack waves."

invariants.rule: A second, distinguishable route or weapon pattern revisits the same objective with greater coverage.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A second, distinguishable route or weapon pattern revisits the same objective with greater coverage."

invariants.rule: The terminal hold preserves surviving units, damaged objective and persistent aftermath on the original map.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal hold preserves surviving units, damaged objective and persistent aftermath on the original map."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
